messages:
Ava (PM): Heads-up: OrionHealth flagged a production regression on their dedicated deployment after yesterday's model swap. They see 5xxs on inference route /v1/generate when context>2k tokens. Support flagged priority-severity for enterprise SLA. Need triage: hotfix vs next release? Thoughts on rollback vs canary?
Support - Maya: Confirming. Customer on Dedicated cluster id ded-03. Error trace attached in ticket #T-8124. They need a fix during their business hours (UTC-5) tomorrow morning.
Rohan (Eng Lead): Can reproduce locally with model-quantized branch; seeing the same kernel OOB when seq_len grows. Is this blocking results or just tails? :thinking_face: 
Priya (PM): Sales says revenue impact if not fixed before Monday. Recommend canary to limited customers then broad if green.
eng-deploy-bot: Canary plan available. Run `/deploy canary --target=ded-03 --image=runtime-v1.3.2-canary` once engineering approves.
Rohan (Eng Lead): I'll open PR and a hotfix branch to guard the q8 kernel. ETA ~6h dev, ~3h test. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/3491
Rohan (Eng Lead): Patch preview:
```diff
- if (qkernel) call q8
+ if (qkernel && model.supports_q8) call q8
```
Samir (SRE): We can route OrionHealth to model-legacy variant cluster-side while canary runs. That avoids downtime. Need a routing config change and short rollout window.
Support - Maya: Customer prefers no outages; they'll accept routing to legacy. Please include communication note to them.
Priya (PM): Decision: proceed with canary + temporary route-to-legacy for OrionHealth. If canary shows <0.1% 5xx and stable latency for 2h, promote. If >0.1% 5xx, abort and escalate hotfix rollback.
Ben (Sales): +1. I'll notify OrionHealth and coordinate a soft maintenance window 10:00-12:00 EST. I'll ask them to opt-in to canary if they'd like early verification.
Ava (PM): Action items: Rohan - open PR & tag release-candidate; Samir - prepare routing change + rollback; SRE - set canary monitors (5xx rate, p95 latency, token cost); Maya - update support ticket and comms; Ben - confirm window with customer. I'll post an update to #incidents and the release doc.
Rohan (Eng Lead): Tagged `release/canary/orion-3491`. Will request QE to run smoke suite on ded-staging now.
eng-deploy-bot: Canary scheduled. Monitor hooks: `canary/metrics` + alert on 5xx >0.05% or p95 > 2x baseline.
Support - Maya: Noted. I'll add the customer's contact and runbook link to ticket: https://support.redwood/tickets/T-8124/runbook
Ben (Sales): Thanks all — pls ping when canary is green so I can tell the customer :thumbsup: 
Ava (PM): Thanks team. Keep thread updated with timestamps when major steps happen. We'll escalate to on-call if anything deviates.
